scope.summary: Implement StudioComponent (hsk.studio.component@1) as the single canonical reusable-definition primitive that subsumes both the component and the symbol, created from a StudioSelectionSet of one or more StudioLayer nodes. Support single-component creation (whole selection -> one main component) and bulk creation (one component per selected top-level node) in one typed command. No source product name ('component','symbol','master') is a Studio type or command name.
expected_tests: argus: create-component action reachable via stable author_id; single + bulk paths
test: single creates one main component from selection; bulk creates one component per top-level node in one command
acceptance_criteria_original: StudioComponent created single + bulk from selection; one canonical primitive; author_id + manual entry

target_entries: Studio / Design Systems / Creating components from a selection

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-DS-001] `StudioComponent` (schema id `hsk.studio.component@1`) is the single canonical reusable-definition primitive. It subsumes both the Figma-class component and the Illustrator-class symbol: a source suite's "symbol" and "component" collapse to one `StudioComponent`, never two features, and no source product name ("component", "symbol", "master") is a Studio type or command name.

[STU-DS-002] A `StudioComponent` is created from a `StudioSelectionSet` of one or more `StudioLayer` nodes. Studio MUST support both single-component creation (the whole selection becomes one main component) and bulk creation (one component per selected top-level node in a single command).

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.
